title: Jonge Turken en Marokkanen op de Nederlandse arbeidsmarkt 1981
authors: Brasse, P., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Instituut voor sociale geografie, Valk, L. van der, Schelven, W. van, Vries, M. de (primary investigator)
contributors: Ministerie van welzijn volksgezondheid en cultuur * Leidschendam
Ministerie van sociale zaken en werkgelegenheid * Den Haag (research initiator)
Instituut voor sociale geografie, UvA * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Labour-market position of young Turkish and Moroccan immigrants. Duration of residence in the Netherlands or other European country / education and training / job history / job satisfaction / job conditions / unemployment / job finding / job of parents, husband or wife / fluency in Dutch language / housekeeping / leisure activities / contacts with Dutch people / organizational membership / remigration / legal residence status. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ organizational membership
